correlation_study.conclusion: All SH>=2.0 / FIT>=1.3 D0 factors are short-interest + price-reversal composites and are mutually ~0.98 correlated (only ONE submittable to the competition). The only genuinely independent dimension found is volatility (SI+ts_std_dev, corr ~0.22), but it caps at SH 1.50 / FIT 1.20. Pure non-reversal combos (volatility, 60d momentum, illiquidity, value) all cap at SH ~0.95-1.24 (batch_d3). Therefore exactly ONE independent competition-grade D0 factor exists on this account.
